title: Calculating a cell potential
caption: E°cell = E°(positive electrode) − E°(negative electrode). For silver and zinc: 0.80 − (−0.76) = 1.56 V. Each silver ion takes one electron, so two are needed for each zinc atom: Zn + 2Ag⁺ → Zn²⁺ + 2Ag.
alt: A zinc half-cell and a silver half-cell joined by a salt bridge, with a voltmeter reading 1.56 V.
description: Silver cathode: Ag⁺ + e⁻ → Ag (E° +0.80 V).
